name: Hover Background Menu
description: Full-screen menu of large serif links where hovering or focusing a link crossfades the background to that item's photo with a slow scale-in settle and clipped circle highlights.
contents: Centered list of menu links, each with a small tag above and a large label
Full-bleed stack of background images, one per item, with dimmed full layer and clip-path circle highlights
behavior: Hover, focus or click on a link fades in that item's background and scales it down from slightly zoomed
Links stack left-aligned on small screens and center on desktop
editableByProps: Number of items, tags, labels and background images
All colors, fonts, link size and weight
Clip-path highlight shapes, dim level, scale and timing, easing

needsCodeEdit.change: Make links navigate to real URLs
needsCodeEdit.where: The a element with onClick preventDefault inside the nav

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the crossfade or scale animation

fixed: Links use href="#" and only drive the background
